subject: general
question: The Goods and Services Tax, which includes both goods and services, was introduced by the Government of India with effect from _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 July 2017**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **GST Bill, **__2014 was passed in** May 2015**. It was __**enacted**__ as Constitution Act, 2016, with effect from, __**16th September, 2016**__. The GST was launched on **1st July 2017**.
 
• It is a **__tax __**levied when a consumer buys a good or service. It is meant to be a **__single, comprehensive tax__** that will __**subsume**__ all the other smaller indirect taxes on consumption like service tax, etc.
 
• It subsumed **__17 large taxes and 13 cesses.__** It is a__** single tax**__ on the supply of goods and services, r**__ight from the manufacturer to the end consumer.__**
 
• It is a step towards __**'One Nation, One Tax'.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• It is Simple and Easy to administer because multiple indirect taxes at the central and state levels are being replaced by a single tax “GST”.
 
• It makes Better control on leakage because of better tax compliance, reduction of rent-seeking, transparency in taxation due to IT use.
 
• It has Higher revenue efficiency since the cost of the collection will decrease along with an increase in the ease of compliance, it will lead to **higher tax revenue.**__
 
• The **__single and transparent__** tax will provide a **__lowering of inflation. __**and provide **__Relief in overall tax burden.__**
 
• It has __**Tax democracy**__ that is luxury items will be**__ taxed more __**and basic goods will be__** tax-free.**__
